open_points.subject: A21 security-review reopening and concurrency coverage of A18
open_points.text: “A change to a decision a category names reopens this review” and “after that day's changes to ... A18 reopened it (rule 2): every category naming them was reviewed, and no outcome and no reference changed.” The concurrency category does not name A18, although A18 specifies concurrent store writes and backup snapshots, non-overlapping runs, and listings racing backup renames or deletions.
open_points.question: When A18 changes, must the concurrency category also be reviewed even though its existing reference list omits A18, or does rule 2 limit the renewed review to the secrets and files_artifacts categories that already name A18?
options: Review concurrency because A18 contains read-check-change races and atomic snapshot rules, potentially changing its references and affected set.
Review only categories whose pre-existing references name A18, leaving concurrency unchanged.
open_points.default_guess: Review concurrency and treat A18 as one of the decisions on which that category rests.

witness.initial: Registry is running with service tokens; the store contains a project, and no backup run is active.
events: At 03:00 UTC Registry starts A18's backup snapshot.
The owner concurrently corrects the project and commits while the backup is being made.
A release reviewer applies the changed A21 rerun statement.
outcomes: The reviewer treats this as an A18 concurrency case, reviews the snapshot/write ordering and A18's atomicity tests, and requires concurrency coverage to rest on A18.
The reviewer follows “every category naming” A18, reviews only secrets and files_artifacts, and accepts the unchanged concurrency references without considering this race.
witness.observer: The security or release reviewer deciding whether the States 0–2 security review is complete.
